description: This source file implements RBUS API interactions for WiFi diagnostics and MLO RFC control, including initialization, get/set handlers, and data model registration.

methods.name: rbusInitializedCheck
methods.description: Checks if rbus handle is initialized.

methods.name: rbus_getBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from rbus given a path.

methods.name: rbus_getStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from rbus given a path.

methods.name: rbus_getUInt32Value
methods.description: Retrieves a uint32 value from rbus given a path.

methods.name: rbus_getApAssociatedDeviceDiagnosticResult
methods.description: Gets associated device diagnostics data for a WiFi access point.

methods.name: rbus_wifi_getRadioTrafficStats2
methods.description: Gets radio traffic statistics for a WiFi radio.

methods.name: set_HarvesterMLORfcEnable
methods.description: Sets MLO RFC enable status and updates PSM.

methods.name: get_HarvesterMLORfcEnable
methods.description: Gets current MLO RFC enable status.

methods.name: rbus_StoreValueIntoPsmDB
methods.description: Stores a parameter value into PSM database.

methods.name: rbus_GetValueFromPsmDB
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from PSM database.

methods.name: regHarvesterDataModel
methods.description: Registers MLO RFC data element with RBUS.
